review_notes: The first focused campaign left compiled-oversized-kept alive because only module and miss counts were compared; see earlier_campaign.

Parsing depends only on the source name, text, and parse limits, and the syntax tree has no interior mutability, so sharing trees cannot leak state; a hit still performs the parser-entry check and all import accounting.

Environment and working directory were already immutable per-run snapshots and HTTP never pooled connections or cookies; the new tests prove those boundaries under concurrency rather than changing them.
The cache is an explicit object owned by an Engine or the CLI invocation, not process-global state, so separate engines stay independent unless a host shares a cache deliberately.
Adding the cache line in the CLI file context moved the text of one secret catalogue entry, which was updated and re-caught.
limits: Entry scripts are still parsed by each run; only imported modules are shared.
The capacity counts module text; parsed trees use memory proportional to it.
Browser and device sessions do not exist yet; their integrations must state session ownership.
Native callbacks registered on an Engine can share captured state by design; hosts own that sharing.

from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone
import subprocess, json, hashlib, re, tempfile, os
root=Path.cwd()
out=Path(tempfile.mkdtemp(prefix="isolation-validation-",dir=root/"target"))
print(f"validation record: {out / 'summary.json'}",flush=True)
def measured():
 inputs=[p for d in ('src','tests','examples') for p in (root/d).rglob('*') if p.is_file() and '__pycache__' not in p.parts]
 inputs += sorted((root/'docs').rglob('*.md')) + sorted((root/'docs').rglob('*.schema.json')) + [root/'README.md']
 inputs += [root/p for p in ('Cargo.toml','Cargo.lock','.cargo/mutants.toml','scripts/coverage.py','scripts/mutation_core.py')]
 return {str(p.relative_to(root)):hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest() for p in sorted(inputs)}
musl_cc=str(root/'target/http-musl-toolchain/root/usr/bin/musl-gcc')
record={'complete':False,'started':datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),'revision':subprocess.check_output(['git','rev-parse','HEAD'],text=True).strip(),'input_sha256':measured(),'musl_compiler':musl_cc,'checks':[]}
musl=['--target','x86_64-unknown-linux-musl']
commands=[('gnu-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked']),('gnu-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release']),('musl-debug-full',['cargo','test','--locked',*musl]),('musl-release-full',['cargo','test','--locked','--release',*musl]),('clippy-gnu',['cargo','clippy','--locked','--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('clippy-musl',['cargo','clippy','--locked',*musl,'--all-targets','--','-D','warnings']),('format',['cargo','fmt','--all','--','--check']),('coverage-helper',['python3','tests/coverage_tools.py']),('mutation-helper',['python3','tests/mutation_tools.py'])]
try:
 for label,command in commands:
  print('running '+label,flush=True)
  log=out/(label+'.log')
  with log.open('w') as stream:
   result=subprocess.run(command,stdout=stream,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT,timeout=2400,env=dict(os.environ,CARGO_BUILD_JOBS='4',CC_x86_64_unknown_linux_musl=musl_cc))
  content=log.read_text()
  rows=re.findall(r'test result: (?:ok|FAILED)\. (\d+) passed; (\d+) failed; (\d+) ignored;',content)
  check={'label':label,'command':command,'status':result.returncode,'log':str(log.relative_to(root)),'tests':dict(zip(('passed','failed','ignored'),[sum(int(row[i]) for row in rows) for i in range(3)])),'log_sha256':hashlib.sha256(log.read_bytes()).hexdigest()}
  record['checks'].append(check)
  (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
  print(json.dumps(check),flush=True)
  if result.returncode:
   print(content[-12000:],flush=True)
   raise SystemExit(result.returncode)
 record['inputs_unchanged']=measured()==record['input_sha256']
 record['complete']=record['inputs_unchanged']
finally:
 record['finished']=datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
 (out/'summary.json').write_text(json.dumps(record,indent=2)+'\n')
print('complete' if record['complete'] else 'INPUTS CHANGED', flush=True)

"""Assemble docs/run-isolation-evidence.json from recorded summaries only."""
from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime, timezone

scratch = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
validation_path, targeted_path, todo_before, repaired_path = (Path(arg).resolve() for arg in sys.argv[1:5])
repaired = json.loads(repaired_path.read_text())
assert repaired["complete"] and repaired["outcomes"][0]["status"] == "passed"
repaired_statuses = {row["id"]: row["status"] for row in repaired["outcomes"][1:]}
assert set(repaired_statuses.values()) == {"caught"}, repaired_statuses
validation = json.loads(validation_path.read_text())
targeted = json.loads(targeted_path.read_text())
assert validation["complete"] and validation["inputs_unchanged"], "validation incomplete or inputs changed"
assert targeted["complete"], "targeted campaign incomplete"
rows = targeted["outcomes"][1:]
statuses = {row["id"]: row["status"] for row in rows}
assert targeted["outcomes"][0]["status"] == "passed"
counts = {status: sum(1 for value in statuses.values() if value == status) for status in ("caught", "missed", "unviable", "timeout", "build_timeout")}
full = [check for check in validation["checks"] if check["label"].endswith("-full")]
totals = {check["tests"]["passed"] for check in full}
assert len(totals) == 1 and all(check["tests"]["failed"] == 0 and check["status"] == 0 for check in validation["checks"])
helper = {}
for check in validation["checks"]:
    if check["label"].endswith("-helper"):
        text = (root / check["log"]).read_text()
        helper[check["label"].replace("-helper", "_tools")] = int(re.search(r"Ran (\d+) tests?", text).group(1))
def sha(path):
    return hashlib.sha256(Path(path).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
drivers = {}
for name in ("isolation-validation.py", "isolation-targeted.py", "isolation-repaired-targeted.py", "isolation-evidence.py"):
    source = (scratch / name).read_text()
